description: TypeScript declaration file defining interfaces, types, and external references for Playwright's internal structures, including Page, Frame, Browser, and various element handles, as well as external modules like 'child_process', 'stream', and 'zod'. It provides type annotations and external API symbols for use in TypeScript projects.

classes.name: Page
classes.description: Interface representing a web page with methods for evaluation, element selection, and script injection.

classes.name: Frame
classes.description: Interface representing a frame within a page, with evaluation and element handling methods.

classes.name: BrowserContext
classes.description: Interface for browser context, managing scripts, bindings, and event listeners.

classes.name: Browser
classes.description: Interface representing a browser instance with event management.

classes.name: Worker
classes.description: Interface for web workers with evaluation capabilities.

classes.name: JSHandle
classes.description: Interface representing a JavaScript handle for evaluation and value retrieval.

classes.name: ElementHandle
classes.description: Interface for DOM element handles with querying and evaluation methods.

classes.name: Locator
classes.description: Interface for element locators with evaluation and handling methods.

classes.name: BrowserType
classes.description: Interface for browser type, with connection methods.

classes.name: CDPSession
classes.description: Interface for Chrome DevTools Protocol session management.

classes.name: WebSocketRoute
classes.description: Interface for WebSocket message and close event handling.

classes.name: errors.TimeoutError
classes.description: Custom error class for timeout errors.

classes.name: ElectronApplication
classes.description: Interface for Electron app evaluation methods.

methods.name: Page.evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates a function in the page context, returning the result.

methods.name: Frame.evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates a function in the frame context.

methods.name: BrowserContext.exposeBinding
methods.description: Exposes a binding in the browser context.

methods.name: Browser.removeAllListeners
methods.description: Removes all event listeners from the browser.

methods.name: Worker.evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates a function in the worker context.
